The section text is the deployment-configurable `Co"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"nfig.section`, defaulting to the guidance quoted verbatim from `src/guidance.ts`."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"##### `src/guidance.ts` — shipped Feynman guidance"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"#### What the model sees"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The `teach` tool is registered unconditionally, so its schema and description are in the request too"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"l catalog on every request regardless of mode; entering or leaving learning mode changes only the pr"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ompt section, never the catalog. Calling `teach` while inactive fails with `teach is only available "},{"id":"p24s4","text":"in learning mode (run /learn)`. The description and parameter schema below are defined in `src/teach"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"arning mode (run /learn)`. The description and parameter schema below are defined in `src/teach.ts`."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"#### What the model sees"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"After each `teach` call the tool result renders one fixed continuation line, and a `/learn` switch i"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"njects a user-role plugin notice when the last logged header described the other mode."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- `teach` result: `Lesson delivered. Continue the Feynman loop: ask the user to teach the concept ba"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ck, or answer their follow-up questions.`
- `/learn on` notice: `The user switched this session to l"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"earning mode.`
- `/learn off` notice: `The user switched this session back to the default mode.`"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Known Limitations and Deferred Work"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **判定为软约束** — the model can skip the teach-back or judgment step; v1 enforces the loop only through"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" the `learning:policy` guidance, not a hard mechanism. A dedicated quiz tool is the deferred path to"},{"id":"p29s3","text":" a hard constraint (SPEC D3).
- **mermaid 体积** — mermaid.js is bundled whole into the client bundle "},{"id":"p29s4","text":"(about 3.3MB raw / 900KB gzip) for offline, deterministic rendering under the plugin's single-file b"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"undle route; `import()` only defers module execution, so download and parse cost recur on every page"},{"id":"p29s6","text":" load (SPEC D6).
- **长内容折叠未做** — an overlong lesson renders fully expanded (v1 accepts this).
- **卡片"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"无结果态** — the toolview consumes only the `tool/call` arguments, so a failed `tool/result` is not refl"},{"id":"p29s8","text":"ected on the card (a failed `teach` is unlikely, and the generic card is the fallback).
- **无跨会话记忆**"},{"id":"p29s9","text":" — each session is independent; mastery and current learning topic are not persisted (D5).
- **无 mod"},{"id":"p29s10","text":"e 投影单元** — the client does not read learning-mode state; a future mode indicator would go through `s"},{"id":"p29s11","text":"essionProjections`.
- **无 i18n 命名空间** — card labels are fixed Chinese prose; localization is deferre"},{"id":"p29s12","text":"d.
- **`/learn` 依赖 `ctx.commands`** — in a headless composition without a command registry `/learn` "},{"id":"p29s13","text":"is unavailable; the prompt section and `teach` tool still work, and `ctx.learningMode.set` remains a"},{"id":"p29s14","text":" non-command switch path."}],"truncated":true}
